# tenure of doxastic state

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenureOfDoxasticState`](gmeow-tenureOfDoxasticState.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureOfDoxasticState>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/epistemics`](../../slices/epistemics.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a [`DoxasticTenure`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticTenure.md) to the [`DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) whose holding interval it records. Functional: one tenure scopes one doxastic state; a revised belief gets a new [`DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) and a new tenure, while the old state and closed tenure remain as audit ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:DoxasticTenure`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:tenureOfDoxasticState`](gmeow-tenureOfDoxasticState.md) from [`gmeow:DoxasticTenure`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticTenure.md) to [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a [`DoxasticTenure`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticTenure.md) to the [`DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) it time-scopes.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the interval (use [`duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md)) and avoid pointing at more than one doxastic state per tenure.

### How to use

- Set exactly once per [`DoxasticTenure`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticTenure.md), pairing it with [`duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md).

### Examples

- ex:aliceRoundTenure [`gmeow:tenureOfDoxasticState`](gmeow-tenureOfDoxasticState.md) ex:aliceBelievesRound.
